save_trigger: OSD opened (F12 from a uinput keyboard) with Autosave on: the core writes its backup RAM to the SD card
started_from: a zero-filled 65536-byte .sav put in place before loading, so the backup RAM started cleared; the core then rewrote all of it
note: 24C01 EEPROM (128 bytes) in a 64 KiB file: the MegaDrive core always writes 128 sectors (MegaDrive.sv: &sd_lba[6:0]); the EEPROM bytes are at 0x00-0x7F, everything after is the zero seed. Byte 0 is 00 where Genesis Plus GX and BlastEm have FC (PicoDrive also 00); bytes 76-77 and 122-127 differ from every libretro core (the boxer's random look and a checksum). Proof: after loading the game again the title menu offers RESUME OLD CAREER and RETIRE BOXER.
